question: The 'SMILE' Scheme, which is a Central Sector Scheme, an acronym of 'Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise' was launched in February 2022 by the Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment, ______, in Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Virendra Kumar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The '**SMILE**' Scheme is a **Central Sector Scheme** launched to support marginalized individuals for livelihood and enterprise.
 
• It was launched in **February 2022 by the Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment**, **Virendra Kumar**, in Delhi.
 
• The scheme is aimed at providing welfare and rehabilitation to the marginalized sections of society, focusing on their socio-economic upliftment.
 
• Key components of the scheme include providing education, skill development, and entrepreneurship opportunities to the beneficiaries.
 
• The scheme is expected to create a significant impact on the lives of marginalized individuals by offering them sustainable livelihood options.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is responsible for the implementation of the SMILE scheme.
 
• The scheme aligns with the government's vision of '**Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas, Sabka Vishwas**' (Collective Efforts, Inclusive Growth, Trust of All).
 
• Various stakeholders, including NGOs and state governments, are involved in the execution of the scheme to ensure its wide reach and effectiveness.
 
• The scheme also focuses on providing health care services and legal support to the beneficiaries.
 
• Periodic reviews and monitoring mechanisms are in place to assess the progress and impact of the scheme on the targeted population.
